title: QBR — Roadmap Chorus: cross-functional readout & decision packet for initiative gating
creator: Leah Park
description:
Purpose: Prepare a concise, decision-ready packet for the upcoming QBR that synthesizes initiative health, operational risk heatmap, and a prioritized investment ask across three customer-impact tranches. This ticket coordinates cross-functional inputs (Eng, Infra, Research, Console, Sales) and captures the final decision pad that will be presented to execs.

Deliverables: 1) 2-page executive one-pager summarizing metrics + asks; 2) Operational heatmap with risk lanes (Latency, Cost, Reliability, Security); 3) Initiative tranche table mapping impact, effort, and recommended funding; 4) Decision slate with binary asks and fallback lanes; 5) Appendices: benchmark runs, canary results, cost model snapshots.

Audience & Meeting: QBR readout with Product + Eng leadership and Finance. Target presentation window: 12 minutes presentation + 8 minutes decision Q&A. Primary stakeholders: Head of Product (A. Mehta), Head of Engineering (S. Chen), VP Finance (R. Osei), Head of Sales (M. Park).

Data sources & links: use the runtime telemetry dashboard (latency-by-model), billing pipeline exports (cost per token by model family), canary logs from dedicated pools, and recent customer escalation incidents (support tickets). Each artifact listed below must be linked in the packet.
